# Pulling an espresso shot

Espresso forces hot water through a puck of fine coffee in under half a minute.

## Dose and yield

Eighteen grams in, about thirty-six grams out, in twenty-five to thirty seconds.

## Tamping

Press the grounds level and firm. An uneven puck lets water find a channel and the shot tastes thin.
